patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Crisp and Intercom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Crisp and Intercom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Crisp only if your buying job matches “Omnichannel messaging with Hugo AI — Free (2 seats); Mini $45; Essentials $95; Plus $295/w” rather than Intercom's shape. Choose Intercom only if your buying job matches “Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.9” rather than Crisp's shape. Workflow advantage: Crisp leans omnichannel-support; Intercom leans customer-messaging, whatsapp-support. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Crisp and Intercom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Crisp is Omnichannel messaging with Hugo AI — Free (2 seats); Mini $45; Essentials $95; Plus $295/workspace/mo. Primary live-chat; CS secondary.; Intercom is Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.99/outcome. Primary live-chat; BC + CS secondary..
- Company-size focus: Crisp (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Intercom (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Crisp-leaning omnichannel-support vs Intercom-leaning customer-messaging, whatsapp-support, contact-center.
- Researched limits: Crisp — Hugo AI usage is credit-metered beyond included plan allotments; Intercom — Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume.

Limitations — Crisp: Hugo AI usage is credit-metered beyond included plan allotments; Extra seats beyond included allotment cost $10/seat/mo on paid plans; Intercom: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume; SMS, WhatsApp and Phone are pay-as-you-go add-on channels, not unlimited included.

Poor-fit cases: Crisp is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Hugo AI usage is credit-metered beyond included plan allotments · Intercom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume · Avoid Crisp if you actually need Intercom's motion (Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
